description: Installation of replacement windows and door.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The work to which this consent relates shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent. 
Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following plans and specifications: LOCATION PLAN RECEIVED ON 10/03/26, SET OF DRAWINGS RECEIVED ON 20/02/26 (DIMENSIONS AND PROFILE FOR LOCATION 1, DIMENSIONS AND PROFILES FOR LOCATIONS 2-7, LOCATION MAP OF WINDOWS AND DOORS TO BE REPLACED), WINDOWS SPECIFICATION DATED 26/01/26.
Reason: To safeguard the character of the building, in accordance with Council policy LP3 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 3 - The windows hereby approved must be of the same dimensions and profile as the original windows. They shall be constructed in timber, with white spacer bars and beading to match the frames. The glazing bars and sash horns of the original windows shall be replicated, and any trickle vents required shall be fully concealed within the frames.
Reason: In the interest of the appearance of the development and to safeguard visual amenity of the conservation area and significance of the Listed Building, in accordance with Council policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
